system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:44:39 UTC, PowerShell ran the documented patch-deployment command from the FILE-HD-01 share as omar.haddad; its child process ran a Windows update package. This is consistent with the organization's stated patching practice, though it is later than the reported approximate 13:40 time.
The workstation received a network logon for omar.haddad from WS-OHADDAD-01, followed by a privileged-logon event. The source matches the inventory's stated remote-administration workstation.

At 13:32:09 UTC, taskhostw.exe on WS-MLOPEZ-01 used explicit credentials for svc-bkp while targeting PROXY-HD-01. The inventory places svc-bkp on FILE-HD-01, so this use from Maria's workstation is unexplained by the supplied evidence; the event alone does not establish successful authentication or malicious use.

Google Drive File Stream started under maria.lopez from Explorer at 14:11:00 UTC. The inventory lists Microsoft 365/OneDrive as approved and says no other cloud-storage services are approved; these records do not show that Google Drive uploaded or synchronized data.
The supplied records show the observed PowerShell process at 13:44:39 UTC, not at approximately 13:40 UTC; they do not independently establish what window the user saw.

known_telemetry_limitations: The records show the PowerShell command line but not the contents, integrity, or actions of Deploy-Patches.ps1.
The supplied process and network records do not directly capture the user's screen or establish which visible window prompted the report.
The explicit-credentials event records an attempted use of svc-bkp credentials but does not establish whether authentication succeeded.
The Google Drive process-start records establish execution, not file synchronization, data access, or exfiltration.
claims_not_established: Whether the reported brief PowerShell window was the patching process observed at 13:44:39 UTC.
Whether svc-bkp credentials were successfully used, why they were presented from WS-MLOPEZ-01, or whether this activity was authorized.
Whether Google Drive File Stream transferred data or was being used for an unauthorized purpose.
Whether any malicious activity occurred on WS-MLOPEZ-01 during the reviewed interval.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve and verify Deploy-Patches.ps1 and the referenced update package, including their hashes and deployment logs; confirm the patch session with omar.haddad.
Correlate the svc-bkp explicit-credentials event with PROXY-HD-01 authentication logs and FILE-HD-01 backup-agent logs around 13:32 UTC.
Check Google Drive File Stream installation and configuration history, its subsequent network activity, and any synchronized or accessed files.
Ask maria.lopez for the observed window's more precise time and circumstances, and correlate with available interactive-session or screen telemetry.
